Subject: Re: Request: extend POC + volume milestones/discounts?

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for sending the SOW. Quick reply with options so procurement has something concrete to evaluate: 

1) Standard short extension (no pricing change) — +14 days, same trial parameters, we provide an ops credit of $1,500 for engineering support (no change to per-token billing).

2) Time-boxed discount ladder — for the 14-day extension only we can add a temporary volume-break discount applied to generated token usage above a threshold:
   - 0-250k tokens: standard rate
   - 250k-750k tokens: 10% off per-token rate for units in this band
   - >750k tokens: 20% off per-token rate for units above 750k

3) Milestone rebate (conditional) — if you hit a predefined milestone (e.g., 80% accuracy on the eval prompt set + 500k tokens processed during the extension) we can issue a one-time credit equal to 15% of billed usage for the extension period (applied to next invoice).

Notes: the ladder and milestone rebate are temporary concessions tied to the extension period only. For customers that convert to a committed package within 30 days we can roll the extension volume toward the first month of committed capacity (subject to committed-minimums).

I've looped in Stephanie (pricing lead) and Priyom (success/ops) to confirm implementation steps and any approvals. If procurement prefers, we can package option 2 + 3 into a one-page amendment.

Best,
Hannah
